messages.subject: break statement in stan
parts:
Sorry for the simple question, but are there break statements for loop breaks in stan? I get an error, so my guess is no, but figured I would ask. The manual says not to use break as a variable name, but never mentions the use of break statements in stan. There are plenty of simple workarounds, so this is more for my curiosity than anything.

Thanks,
-Kevin

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] break statement in stan

Not yet, but it's on the to-do list. We had
to reserve all the keywords that are reserved in
C++ anyway, or we'd have other issues. See:

http://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/keyword

- Bob
